class.name: CFFISpan
class.brief_description: Object that provides access to a finite number of contiguous elements in memory.

method.name: duplicate
method.description: Duplicate data into a new [CFFIOwnedArray].

method.name: from
method.description: Create a new span from a pointer and a count. If [param pointer] is [code]null[/code] or [param count] is negative, prints an error and returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_pointer
method.description: Get a pointer for the element at [param index]. If the index is out of bounds, prints an error and returns [code]null[/code]. Alias for [code]data.offset_by(index)[/code].

method.name: get_string_from_ascii
method.description: Get a String from this span, using ASCII encoding. This span should contain elements with 1 byte, such as [code]char[/code] or [code]int8_t[/code]. It's an error to read ASCII strings from elements with more than 1 byte.

method.name: get_string_from_utf8
method.description: Get a String from this span, using UTF-8 encoding. This span should contain elements with 1 byte, such as [code]char[/code] or [code]int8_t[/code]. It's an error to read UTF-8 strings from elements with more than 1 byte.

method.name: get_string_from_utf16
method.description: Get a String from this span, using UTF-16 encoding. This span should contain elements with 2 bytes, such as [code]char16_t[/code] or [code]int16_t[/code]. It's an error to read UTF-16 strings from elements with any size other than 2 bytes.

method.name: get_string_from_utf32
method.description: Get a String from this span, using UTF-32 encoding. This span should contain elements with 4 bytes, such as [code]char32_t[/code] or [code]int32_t[/code]. It's an error to read UTF-32 strings from elements with any size other than 4 bytes.

method.name: get_string_from_wchar
method.description: Get a String from a span of [code]wchar_t[/code]. This span should contain elements with [code]sizeof(wchar_t)[/code] bytes, such as [code]wchar_t[/code]. Note that the size of [code]wchar_t[/code] is platform-dependent. It's an error to read wide strings from elements with any size other than [code]sizeof(wchar_t)[/code] bytes.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Get the value at [param index]. If the index is out of bounds, prints an error and returns [code]null[/code]. Alias for [code]get_pointer(index).get_value()[/code].

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the span has no elements.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value at [param index]. If the index is out of bounds, prints an error and returns [code]false[/code]. Alias for [code]get_pointer(index).set_value(value)[/code].

method.name: subspan
method.description: Returns part of the span from the position [param from] with [param count] elements. If [param count] is -1 (as by default), returns the rest of the span starting from the given position. Passing [param from] or [param count] that would grow the bounds of the span will print an error and return [code]null[/code].

method.name: to_array
method.description: Get an [Array] with the values of this span using [method get_value].

method.name: to_byte_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedByteArray]. The size of the result [PackedByteArray] is equal to [member size_bytes].

method.name: to_color_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedColorArray]. Element type must have the size of a [code]Color[/code].

method.name: to_float32_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedFloat32Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]float[/code].

method.name: to_float64_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedFloat64Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]double[/code].

method.name: to_int32_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedInt32Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]int32_t[/code].

method.name: to_int64_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedInt64Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]int64_t[/code].

method.name: to_vector2_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedVector2Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]Vector2[/code].

method.name: to_vector3_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedVector3Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]Vector3[/code].

method.name: to_vector4_array
method.description: Get a copy of the memory of the span as a [PackedVector4Array]. Element type must have the size of a [code]Vector4[/code].

members.member: Pointer to the first element of the span.
Type of elements of the span. Alias for [code]data.element_type[/code].
Number of elements in the span.
Size of the span in bytes. Alias for [code]length * element_type.size[/code].
